references.text: The preceding verse describes how the Israelites killed all the inhabitants of Ai in the open country and in the wilderness, leading to the total number mentioned in verse 25.
Moses' command to strike the inhabitants of the cities with the ban, leaving no survivors, as Israel carried out at Ai.
The law that Israel must not let anyone live in the Canaanite cities but must strike them with the ban, as they did at Ai.
Parallel to the conquest of Jericho, where all living things were struck with the ban—men and women, young and old.
The same pattern is followed in the conquest of Makkedah, where Joshua strikes the city with the ban and everyone in it.
The conquest of Hazor follows the same pattern, where all the inhabitants were killed with the sword.
